Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting files using a flawed encryption scheme
Encryption scheme flaw exploited to create a decrypter
File encryption requiring encrypted and unencrypted file pairs to derive decryption key
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with encrypted files by HydraCrypt and UmbreCrypt ransomware
Indicators of Compromise: Encrypted files with extensions targeted by HydraCrypt and UmbreCrypt
